description: This file defines a Kivy widget for a color picker, including classes for color input fields, a color wheel, and the main ColorPicker widget, with methods for color selection and interaction handling.

classes.name: ColorHexInput
classes.description: A TextInput subclass for editing hexadecimal color codes, with input filtering and focus handling.

classes.name: ColorNumericInput
classes.description: A TextInput subclass for numeric color values (0-255), with input validation.

classes.name: ColorWheel
classes.description: A widget displaying a chromatic color wheel with touch interaction for color selection and zooming.

classes.name: ColorArc
classes.description: An internal class representing a segment of the color wheel, with methods for mesh generation and color changing.

classes.name: ColorPicker
classes.description: The main widget combining color wheel, inputs, and properties for selecting and displaying colors.

methods.name: _filter_hex
methods.description: Filters input to allow only '#' and up to 8 hex digits for hex color input.

methods.name: on_focus
methods.description: Restores valid hex color when focus is lost if input is incomplete.

methods.name: _filter_numeric
methods.description: Filters input to allow only integers 0-255 for numeric color input.

methods.name: distance
methods.description: Calculates Euclidean distance between two points.

methods.name: polar_to_rect
methods.description: Converts polar coordinates to rectangular coordinates.

methods.name: rect_to_polar
methods.description: Converts rectangular coordinates to polar coordinates relative to an origin.

methods.name: ColorWheel
methods.description: Handles rendering and interaction with the color wheel, including touch gestures and color updates.

methods.name: inertial_incr_sv_idx
methods.description: Increments the saturation/value index with inertial scrolling effect.

methods.name: inertial_decr_sv_idx
methods.description: Decrements the saturation/value index with inertial scrolling effect.

methods.name: on_touch_down
methods.description: Handles touch down events for color wheel interaction.

methods.name: on_touch_move
methods.description: Handles touch move events for zooming or color selection.

methods.name: on_touch_up
methods.description: Handles touch release events, including pinch zoom and color selection.

methods.name: _get_touch_r
methods.description: Calculates distance from touch point to wheel origin.

methods.name: _ColorArc
methods.description: Represents a segment of the color wheel with mesh and color change capabilities.

methods.name: change_color
methods.description: Updates the color of a segment.

methods.name: ColorPicker
methods.description: Main widget for color selection, combining color wheel, inputs, and properties.

methods.name: set_color
methods.description: Sets the current color, updating internal state.
